messages:
maria: quick flag — the v1->v2 migration doc still shows `response_stream: true`. v2 expects `stream: true` and the streaming chunk format changed, so current Go/Rust examples will break if users copy them.

kevin: can you paste the exact example so i can see the minimal change?

maria: current inline example: `{"model":"text-chat-v1","response_stream":true,"input":"Hi"}`. minimal v2-correct form: `{"model":"chat-v2","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}`. also add a short note in the "model swaps" section about embed alias fallback semantics (auto-routing possible but may degrade).

oliver: i'll open a small PR that updates the canonical migration page + api/streaming examples and then run a repo grep for any stray `response_stream`. planning branch docs/stream-param-cleanup and a tiny grep-based test.

docs-bot: ticket DOCS-8990 created: Update streaming param + embed-fallback note. PR created: https://git.company.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/1301 (labels: docs, needs-review).

sam: we should add a one-line changelog under Breaking Changes so customers see the rename in release notes.

maria: agreed. suggested blurb: "streaming parameter renamed from `response_stream` to `stream`. Calls using the old param will be routed but please migrate to `stream` to avoid future errors. Explicit embed fallback recommended (e.g., `embed-regular-v2`)." keep it short.

kevin: i'll prototype an MDX linter rule to flag `response_stream` in markdown so we don't regress.

oliver: PR is up, assigning @maria and @kevin for review. staging deploy scheduled if CI passes.

maria: perfect — thanks. i'll add the release-note blurb to the 2.0 changelog draft after CI green. :rocket:
